description: Canonical intermediate representation. Every producer emits it, every stage reads only it. Reconciled with HOOLULU/IMGCODE CANON v1.0 §5: canon fields are optional; v0.3 trees without them remain valid.

approval_points.description: Canon §5: explicit approval points (also derived from node human_approval flags)

dependencies.description: Canon §5: [before, after] id pairs (also derived from node requires)

edges.description: Canon §5: explicit edges (parent links are derived into edges automatically)

name.description: Canon §5: human name (defaults to root label)

human_approval.description: Canon §5: this node needs Xavier's approval

parent.description: Parent node id; root's children use the root id

purpose.description: Canon §5 alias of note; must agree if both present

requires.description: Canon §5: node ids that must complete before this one

type.description: Canon §5 alias of kind; must agree if both present
